summary: State of an offline NavCloud generation run (editor/tool feature: the last phase can run a 'p4 ... reconcile' on the written file). navcloud::generate::GenerationSystem (per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3932DC0, macOS navcloud::generate::GenerationSystem::Update with GenerateDataComponent, TransformComponent, RegionLoadingComponent, GenerateEventOneFrameComponent, IsWaitingForGenerateComponent, ZoneComponent) creates a new entity with this component (creator bg3.exe+0x39341F0, 0x88 bytes), stores a path built with the 'NavCloud' folder name at +0 and sets State = 1; then walks State 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4: phase-1 jobs fill a map of cells, phase-2 jobs mark bytes in each cell's array, phase 3 runs one write job, State 4 destroys the entity. Client-only registry row. Never seen alive.

fields.name: field_0
fields.evidence: key of the cell map: 12 bytes (keys iterated with stride 0xC at bg3.exe+0x3932DC0 and bg3.exe+0x393A1D0), hashed as k0 ^ k1 ^ k2 - three 32-bit integers, probably cell coordinates.

fields.name: field_4
fields.evidence: second integer of the 12-byte key, see field_0.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: third integer of the 12-byte key, see field_0.

fields.name: Resolution
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x393A1D0 writes the job's level here and keeps the finer one on collisions: 0 -> cell size 3.0, 1 -> 1.0, else 9999999.0 (same mapping when jobs are created in bg3.exe+0x3932DC0, 6/size cubed = job work count).

fields.name: _Pad4
fields.evidence: padding before the 8-aligned array; never written.

fields.name: Flags
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x393A1D0 moves an Array{ptr,cap,size} here (value+8/+0x10/+0x14); State-2 handling in bg3.exe+0x3932DC0 sets bit 0 of byte [index] of this buffer for each int index a phase-2 job reports; the map destructor bg3.exe+0x6D0580 clears and frees it (value stride 0x18).

fields.name: HashKeys
fields.evidence: HashMap<CellKey, Cell> (64 bytes) laid out as Script Extender's HashMap (CoreLib\Base\BaseMap.h): StaticArray<int32_t> HashKeys {ptr, size}; bucket count read at +8 (bg3.exe+0x393A1D0: hash % *(int*)(map+8)). Written as raw members because the key is a struct of this file.

fields.name: HashKeysSize
fields.evidence: bucket count, see HashKeys.

fields.name: _PadC
fields.evidence: padding of the StaticArray.

fields.name: NextIds
fields.evidence: HashSet NextIds; creator bg3.exe+0x39341F0 zeroes it (size u32 at map+0x1C).

fields.name: Keys
fields.evidence: keys array at map+0x20 (component +0x68), capacity +0x28, size +0x2C; iterated with stride 0xC in bg3.exe+0x3932DC0.

fields.name: Values
fields.evidence: values buffer (UninitializedStaticArray<Cell>) at map+0x30, elements of 0x18 bytes (bg3.exe+0x6D0580, bg3.exe+0x393A1D0).

fields.name: ValuesSize
fields.evidence: values capacity compared with keys capacity map+0x28 before growing (bg3.exe+0x393A1D0).

fields.name: _Pad3C
fields.evidence: padding to 64 bytes.

fields.name: Path
fields.evidence: destructor bg3.exe+0x6C6050 frees a 24-byte game string at +0; per-frame update bg3.exe+0x3932DC0 assigns a path built by bg3.exe+0xF822F0 with the 'NavCloud' folder name (PTR_s_NavCloud_14589a1d8) right after creating the component; the State-3 write job copies it (bg3.exe+0x3932DC0 line with STDString(job+0x10, component)) and the optional p4 reconcile uses the file.

fields.name: State
fields.evidence: creator bg3.exe+0x39341F0 writes 1; bg3.exe+0x3932DC0 switches on it: 1 = start region jobs -> 2, 2 = start cell jobs -> 3, 3 = write job -> 4, 4 = destroy the entity.

fields.name: _Pad1C
fields.evidence: padding before the 8-aligned array; never written.

fields.name: RegionJobs
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3932DC0 (State 1) appends pointers to 0xA0-byte job objects (FUN_143939980) here, pushes them to the worker scheduler, then merges each into CellMap (bg3.exe+0x393A1D0), frees it and sets size +0x2C = 0; destructor bg3.exe+0x6C6050 frees the buffer (plain Array).

fields.name: CellJobs
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3932DC0 (State 2) appends pointers to 0x50-byte job objects (vtable bg3.exe+0x589A288), one per CellMap key, then marks their results in CellMap values and clears size +0x3C; destructor bg3.exe+0x6C6050 frees the buffer.

fields.name: WriteJob
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3932DC0 (State 3) creates a 0x38-byte job (vtable bg3.exe+0x589A228, holding a copy of Path and a pointer to CellMap) when this is null, waits, frees it; creator writes 0; not touched by the destructor.

fields.name: CellMap
fields.evidence: HashMap<12-byte key, 24-byte cell> at +0x48: destructor bg3.exe+0x6D0580 (called by bg3.exe+0x6C6050 on +0x48) frees each value's array (stride 0x18, count = keys size map+0x2C) then the HashSet (FUN_140582AD0); creator bg3.exe+0x39341F0 zeroes +0x48..+0x88.

open_questions: Meaning of the three integers of the cell key (probably cell coordinates) and of the per-cell byte flags.
Names are inferred from the code; the component is not saved, not replicated, and the Toolkit has no named accessor.
